notes:
Fresh AI poke messages every session:
 - 25 s after PokeFlow starts, the local AI writes 10 NEW messages for each poke stage (Poke 1, then 2, then 3) in
   the background. Ctrl+Q / Ctrl+S use a stage's fresh messages as soon as that stage is ready; until then - and on
   PCs without the AI or without a real graphics card - the 30 built-in messages are used (they never go away).
 - Every AI message is checked before use: right length for its stage, "babe" exactly once (his name goes there),
   no money / other apps / meeting up / links, no FansMetric banned words, not a copy of another message.
   Fewer than 5 good ones for a stage -> that stage keeps the built-in messages.
 - Skipped without a graphics card (8 GB GPU recommended): writing on the CPU would slow the PC down for minutes.
 - The local AI runs at lower priority while it writes. badges_debug.txt says how long each stage took.
 - The duplicate check works with the fresh messages too (never pastes one he already has).
